stemMarkdown: Next year the household's monthly income rises to Rs 75,000 and rent falls to 24% of income. What will the household then spend on rent each month, in rupees?
solutionMarkdown:
$75{,}000 \times \dfrac{24}{100} = 18{,}000$

**Rs 18000** — exactly what it is today. The rent **share** drops by 6 percentage points and the rent **amount** does not move at all, because the base grew by 25% at the same time. A pie chart shows shares only, so no change in a slice can be read as a change in an amount unless you know what happened to the total.
